scope: Audit snapshot of declared requirements; not a live capability manifest or an implemented release enforcer
acceptance_status: No full product gate accepted by this audit; partial evidence is described per gate

gates.requirement: All twelve complete motor interfaces fitted on one motherboard, at least eight usable motors, individual enable and alarm on every channel
gates.evidence_required: One versioned circuit/protocol/RTL/driver/service contract; independent electrical pin checks; all-channel pulse, enable, alarm, feedback and fault tests with eight- and twelve-motor machine configurations on the fitted twelve-interface board
gates.current_state: Open. Source26 represents all twelve STEP/DIR, enable and alarm interfaces; 3,508 required board joins remain in the last verified ROOT104 baseline. Complete CNC3/RTL/HAL and vendor/physical qualification remain unfinished. Historical runtime is six/two.

gates.requirement: 24 general DI and 16 smart general DO remain available with all twelve motor interfaces
gates.evidence_required: Fitted interface allocation, loading/isolation/protection, protocol and full-cycle tests; home/alarm functions do not consume promised general I/O unnoticed
gates.current_state: Open. Source26 represents 24 general DI and 16 smart DO with acquisition/control circuitry. Full routing, actual concurrent I/O runtime and electrical/thermal qualification remain unfinished.

gates.requirement: Serially communicated local I/O/real accessories validate versioned board/region or actual-module identity, sequence/freshness and CRC before outputs change
gates.evidence_required: Receiver validation and versioned board-region framing; corruption, replay, wrong identity, timeout, actual-module removal, reset and output-default tests; no fabricated card-presence/serial data
gates.current_state: Open. Marker bits/readback alone are insufficient.

gates.requirement: Independent fault-to-inhibit bound no greater than 20 ms for declared covered faults
gates.evidence_required: Worst-case detection plus propagation budget and measured acceptance over clock stall, link loss, brownout/reset and interlock cases; distinguish electrical inhibit from mechanical stopping
gates.current_state: Open for current dual TPS3851 candidate integrated in MC r0.4. Historical TPS3431 screened approximately 64–72 ms and failed. Current [numerical review](../reports/next-implementation-20260930/WATCHDOG_NUMERICAL_REVIEW.md) retains conditional leakage/setup assumptions, open guaranteed SET1 timing and unqualified full-path/self-test bounds; no physical 20 ms acceptance is established. A clocked FPGA timer alone does not cover clock stall.

gates.requirement: Reliable full exchange at 1 kHz, completion target 700 microseconds under defined worst-case load
gates.evidence_required: Selected host/PREEMPT_RT image, fitted motion/I/O population, bus transaction and scheduling measurements; graphics/CAD, storage, networking, diagnostics and accessory load together; declared sample scope and worst observed latency
gates.current_state: Open. Mock SPI and simulation wire arithmetic do not qualify a physical cycle.

gates.requirement: 72-hour combined-load run plus fault injection with all twelve motors and any offered encoder/process expansion operating together
gates.evidence_required: Controlled revision/profile/load recipe, elapsed-time record and denominators, deadline/fault/step counters, injected faults and restart evidence; no silent interruption
gates.current_state: Open. No such physical trial.

gates.requirement: Power/protection works at the declared voltage/load/environment limits across all populations
gates.evidence_required: Complete rail and startup/fault budget, exact fuses/clamps/MPNs, sourced physical pins, PDN/stability/thermal review, sequencing and measured partial-power/transient behavior
gates.current_state: Open. Historical expanded central-power arithmetic exceeded its 6 A budget in required cases. The historical reset physical-pin defect was repaired and propagated; MC r0.4 has local rail generation/window supervision with native ERC zero. Complete product loads, protection, PDN/routing, sequencing/partial-power, transient/thermal and physical tests remain unqualified.

gates.requirement: Every displayed measurement has validity and age; stale/disconnected never appears as plausible zero
gates.evidence_required: One telemetry schema, declared acquisition/calibration path and accuracy/load range; disconnected/stale/corrupt sensor tests through service and UI
gates.current_state: Open. Source26 represents output current/fault acquisition paths. Complete routing, calibration, actual firmware/transport and deployed validity/age UI remain unqualified.

gates.requirement: Hardware-backed output/supply/module/temperature diagnostics and power-loss-tolerant local fault history
gates.evidence_required: Exact protected output and full acquisition/isolation/channel-selection cost; declared supported current/open-load features; actual interrupted-write and replay tests; measured facts separate from AI estimates
gates.current_state: Open. IC or GPIO reservations are not complete diagnostics.

gates.requirement: Eight of ten first-time users reach a verified low-speed jog within 15 minutes on the reference machine
gates.evidence_required: Defined start point and timing, fixed approved machine/drive/sensor profile, consented novice sample, successful wiring/commissioning/jog criteria, error/support record
gates.current_state: Open. Older app-interaction timing exercises are separate metrics.

gates.requirement: Replace approved purchased compute/ESP/settings modules with power off; separately exchange a motherboard through retained terminal/harness groups without conductor retermination, ordinary customer soldering/programming or lost configuration
gates.evidence_required: Keyed sockets and terminal/harness drawings; tested programmed module/board spares with real identities/calibration; distinct timed offline module and whole-board trials, wrong-part/plug rejection and appropriately broad affected verification; published spare prices; no unmeasured five-minute board guarantee
gates.current_state: Open. Historical file-only virtual-card replacement evidence does not qualify current module or whole-board service.

gates.requirement: Machine configuration survives interrupted writes and compatible compute/module replacement
gates.evidence_required: Qualified protected removable commodity settings media plus deliberate mirror/export authority; two validated committed records; identity/conflict handling and power-loss trials; machine settings separate from firmware and module calibration
gates.current_state: Open. Host file/journal models do not qualify physical storage.

gates.requirement: No automatic motion resume after a fault, power loss or service replacement
gates.evidence_required: Reset/session/configuration/required-mask validation, explicit restart and re-verification; live position/homing/job authority never restored from saved calibration
gates.current_state: Partly demonstrated in six/two simulation; expanded physical product open.

gates.requirement: One service contract for UI, CLI and assistants; discover, validate, preview/diff, reversible configuration within real limits
gates.evidence_required: Versioned schemas and capability discovery tied to physical identities; stopped/disarmed transactions, audit/rollback/recovery, concurrent-client and bounds tests through both UI and CLI
gates.current_state: Partial disconnected profiles plus separate bounded runtime XYZ service. Production unification open.

gates.requirement: Preserve the intended Octopus/MR-1 experience and provide CAD/model and no-CAD setup routes
gates.evidence_required: Confirmed source reference, model units/orientation/registration, machine/plate/vise/stock workflows, commanded versus measured position, warnings limited to modeled registered objects, novice acceptance
gates.current_state: Open. Scene metadata validation is not the requested renderer or CAD workflow.

gates.requirement: Qualify every offered screen/host package independently of I/O tier
gates.evidence_required: Exact display/touch/compute SKUs, electrical/software compatibility, mounting/cooling/power, physical touch targets, loaded real-time/graphics tests and complete cost
gates.current_state: Open for all screen classes. Connector shape is not compute compatibility.

gates.requirement: ESP supports qualified accessory sequences with one output owner and measured readiness
gates.evidence_required: Actual protected I/O/sensors, bounded request/readiness protocol, essential-service fault/after-run/recovery policy and physical qualification; no autonomous motion authority
gates.current_state: Open. Present target-compiled firmware is diagnostic-only.

gates.requirement: AI stays optional; operation, diagnostics, commissioning and recovery work without internet or AI credit
gates.evidence_required: Independent compute/power/link contract, capability-limited proposals and deterministic validation, companion-loss tests and equivalent deterministic workflows
gates.current_state: Architecture recorded; installed integration open.

gates.requirement: Paid software works offline and survives legitimate module replacement without repurchase
gates.evidence_required: Entitlement/recovery design, offline/missing/corrupt/clock/compute/motion/I/O replacement cases; licence never blocks stop/inhibit, diagnostics or recovery; review actual distribution licensing boundary and SBOM/notices
gates.current_state: Policy recorded; implementation/distribution review open.

gates.requirement: Customers can buy ordinary proven compatible peripherals elsewhere
gates.evidence_required: Published exact tested drive/sensor/VFD/adapter/accessory versions, wiring/limits/firmware/fault behavior and source-neutral profiles; kit value is integration and support
gates.current_state: Policy recorded; qualified physical compatibility list open.

gates.requirement: Plasma upgrades retain unaffected setup and support the first divided-voltage module with two qualified source/harness profiles
gates.evidence_required: Module/harness/cutter/process identity, calibration/affected-verification rules, bounded torch/Z ownership and exact electrical interface tests
gates.current_state: Planning only. Raw/HF interfaces are separate future qualifications.

gates.requirement: PCBWay turnkey and complete product economics are reviewable before ordering
gates.evidence_required: Complete schematic and routed PCB, ERC/DRC, exact BOM/placement/fabrication/programming/test package; quotes at 1/10/100/1,000; complete package/support/yield/warranty and replacement costs
gates.current_state: Open. The last verified Source26/ROOT104 baseline has 1,101 incomplete multi-pad nets and 3,508 required joins. [Current partial BOM](../reports/motherboard-cost-20260930/source-r26-2688-complete-cost-v11/README.md) leaves 185 MPNs/720 purchased pieces unpriced; complete assembly/module/screen cost and manufacturer quotes remain missing. No Gerber/drill/final assembly release or manufacturing-ready claim.

gates.requirement: Twelve simultaneous STEP/DIR channels at up to 2 MHz/channel with individually enforced STEP-high/low, DIR-setup/hold, polarity and maximum-rate profiles; atomic twelve-channel updates in a deterministic 1 kHz LinuxCNC servo cycle
gates.evidence_required: Reviewed parameter/rate boundaries and protocol semantics; twelve-channel RTL simulation and vendor fit/timing; drive-specific electrical limits; loaded target transport/jitter tests; simultaneous physical pulse counts, reversal and fault/inhibit measurements
gates.current_state: Open. New isolated twelve-generator HDL sweep passes 144 cases and exact DDS boundary checks; experimental 12/12 ticks has effectively no margin at 2 MHz. Complete twelve-channel CNC3 endpoint, dynamic timing profiles, actual driver/cable timing, target load and hardware qualification remain unfinished. Historical six-channel 195,312.5 pulses/s runtime limit is unchanged.

gates.requirement: Four base ABZ encoder paths plus qualified expansion toward twelve ABZ channels, simultaneously with all twelve motor interfaces and preserved I/O/process functions
gates.evidence_required: Exact actual spare FPGA resources and expansion-connector contacts for eight more ABZ channels without taking any mandatory motor/I/O function; acquisition bandwidth/counters and current 96/176-byte CNC3 feedback/validity capacity, with any necessary future protocol version explicitly unimplemented; protected supplies and protocol freshness; vendor fit; simultaneous loaded encoder/motor/IO timing and physical faults
gates.current_state: Open expansion target. Four base receiving paths are represented in current source; source representation is distinct from four- or twelve-encoder runtime and physical qualification. No custom motor daughterboard is introduced.

gates.requirement: Pre-fabrication performance limits and one-command virtual bench, with simulated/design/datasheet/physical evidence kept separate
gates.evidence_required: [15-subsystem characterization register](../reports/pre-hardware-characterization-20261001/characterization-register-r03/requirements-and-coverage.json), exact-source actual RTL/CNC3/HAL integration, all12 pulse counts and dynamic profiles, nine mechanical/UX machine profiles,22 fault cases, voltage/temperature/tolerance corners, concurrent worst load, source-bound SPICE, final-route SI/power/thermal and Efinity fit/static timing; retain seeded failure traces and provisional datasheet without invented qualified ratings
gates.current_state: Partial actual component evidence:144 steady twelve-generator cases plus dynamic/reversal and four-encoder sweeps pass; CNC3 structural SPI/codec/family mapping and selected passive/buffer SPICE pass. Stateful CNC3/HAL,complete analog chain,full-load machine,vendor fit and physical qualification remain unfinished.

gates.requirement: AI acts as a grounded CNC setup specialist, produces a validated supported setup efficiently and protects the roughly US$15 API allowance
gates.evidence_required: [AI setup contract](AI_SETUP_CONTRACT.md): exact board/equipment/firmware evidence, saved dependency-aware intake, deterministic calculations and limits, shared UI/CLI/AI preview/commit, separate deliberate commissioning, durable spending reservations and bounded retries; AI01–AI19 with actual cost/quality results and no unsafe accepted action; offline fallback and G10 novice proof
gates.current_state: Open. Controller has simulated profiles and bounded separate runtime services; no integrated setup expert, customer frontend, approved physical profile catalog or cost enforcement. External candidate keyword assistant fails negation/intent tests and is not adopted.
